scenario.summary: Signed in, on the configurable PDP: verifies the Frequently Bought section title and its product names and prices.
steps: Scroll to the Frequently Bought section
assertions: Product names equal the linked products
Product prices equal the linked products' prices
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): configurableProductSearchForConfigurableProduct runs first and declares every record need of the chain (product, variant1..variant8); the migrated class keeps the resolved records in class fields and the later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when a field is null), so they declare no product needs of their own. This method reads variant5.frequentlyBought (class field; linked products are the parent's, the same on every variant row).

Read by the page object, not scanned: the product names and prices come from TestData.getHashMap tables (SIMPLE_PRODUCT_FREQUENTLY_BOUGHT products / price) -> names: variant5.frequentlyBought ('SKU:name|...' of the parent's active linked products in display order). No source entries: the cells are not in the scan.

Gap (needsReview): the linked products' prices have no output on PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_VARIANT_OF_PARENT (as on the approved PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_PDP_DETAILS); the migrated test keeps the price check only for the preferred record or checks that a price is shown.
The section title is UI text: expected-output.

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the class signs in once in configurableProductSearchForConfigurableProduct with loginPage.successfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/configurableProductPDPTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B176/C176) and every later method works in that signed-in session (its cart, wishlist, review). An account lease is held by the declaring method only, so each method declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium quickOrder retail entries. Username/password stay credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet; the scanner recorded them only on the head method, here the same two cells are declared from the test source (the session it reuses).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart/quickOrder entries and the Playwright pdp entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays, image extension) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.

2026-11-06: the price gap is closed: the unscanned price table (SIMPLE_PRODUCT_FREQUENTLY_BOUGHT_PRICE, ProductPrice0..n) now comes from variant5.frequentlyBoughtPrices ('SKU:price|...', aligned with frequentlyBought, Tda.money).
